params.caption: 🖥️ AMD now powers over 40% of the TOP500 supercomputers The new TOP500 list, published at SC26, shows AMD's share up 14% on last year. Its new Lux system debuts at No. 14 with EPYC CPUs and Instinct MI355X GPUs, one of two machines AMD is building under a $1 billion deal with the U.S. Department of Energy. 🕒 Nov 17, 2026 · 00:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 👥 @AMD 🚀 Team Red on a roll?
